💷 From 25 August, unions can ballot for strikes electronically, by hybrid post/online, or in the workplace, ending decades of all-postal voting.

It's the union, not an independent body, that decides which method to use. This lands as the NHS is still recovering from a year of strikes that cost 171,776 appointments.
